questions.question: The LORD told a man He spoke to that he must not marry or have sons or daughters in his land. True or false?
What did the LORD say the sons and daughters born in the land of the man He spoke to would die from?

answers.text: A great flood over the land
Fire raining down from the sky

questions.question: The LORD told a man He spoke to that He would remove something from the land in the people's own days. What was it?

answers.text: The sounds of joy and gladness
The walls and gates of the city
The king and his whole army

questions.question: The LORD promised to bring the banished Israelites back to the land He gave their forefathers. True or false?
